story_type: bomb disposal team finds a buried round on a forbidden island and blows it in place
hook: No one may set foot on this island without a bomb tech.
narration: This island is so full of live explosives, no one walks it alone.
Browns Island sits inside Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune, North Carolina, in the middle of a live fire impact area.
Anyone who goes ashore must be escorted by an explosive ordnance disposal technician.
On May twenty first, Marine and Navy bomb techs landed to patrol for unexploded rounds.
They found an old projectile half buried in the sand, and dug around it by hand.
[short pause] Then one of them spotted a wire.
Moving an old round can set it off, so disposal teams usually place a charge beside it and destroy it where it lies.
The team pulled back across the sand, and the tech keyed his radio.
outcome: The charge went off on the beach, and the team took their boats back off Browns Island.
title: Island full of live bombs
description:
Marine Corps and Navy explosive ordnance disposal technicians patrol Browns Island at Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune, North Carolina, on May 21, 2026, and carry out a demolition of unexploded ordnance.
